subject_session: sub-Mouse12/ses-Mouse12-120807 (named as target, never actually loaded)

headline_stat.name: HD cells identified / mean modulation index

stated_limitation: We attempted to use LINDI (Linked Data Interface) for streaming access; when that was unavailable, we generated high-fidelity synthetic data with realistic neural properties (Poisson spike generation with von Mises directional tuning).

justification.dataset: The agent correctly named the canonical HD dataset (000056, Peyrache) and a real session path, but never successfully loaded it, so the choice is only nominal.
justification.handling: No real data was loaded: LINDI returned 404 and the remfile fallback failed, so the entire analysis ran on hardcoded synthetic von Mises spike trains, an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: The modulation-index method is run only on synthetic data, uses no circular tuning statistic (Rayleigh/mean-vector) or shuffle control, and therefore does not test the real phenomenon.
justification.correctness: The README's headline numbers (6 HD cells, MI 0.889, 78.3°) do not reproduce from the committed analysis.log, which reports 15 units, MI=1.000, 0 HD cells and NaN characteristics.
justification.figures: Figures are readable but display synthetic data with an artifactual head-direction range of only ~75–300°, and thus do not show the claimed real HD-cell phenomenon.
justification.honesty: The write-up buries the synthetic fallback in methods while presenting the synthetic numbers as 'Key Findings' and interpreting them as 'consistent with published descriptions of head direction cells,' presenting an unsupported result as real.
